content: Regular social interaction, music, light exercise, and family communication can help reduce loneliness in elderly individuals.
Deep breathing exercises, meditation, calming music, and regular sleep can help reduce stress.
Maintaining a fixed sleep schedule, reducing caffeine intake, and avoiding screens before bedtime may improve sleep quality.
Walking, stretching, chair yoga, and light physical activity are beneficial for elderly health.
Balanced meals including fruits, vegetables, proteins, and hydration are important for elderly nutrition.
Medicines should be taken on time and according to doctor's instructions.
Talking with loved ones, engaging in hobbies, and seeking emotional support can improve mental wellbeing.
